name: Camoufox
description: Anti-detect Firefox Playwright WebSocket server with integrated Selkies live browser viewer (/viewer/), built on official daijro/camoufox with C++ fingerprint spoofing, virtual Xvfb display support, optional GeoIP matching, proxy configuration, /json discovery, and optional token authentication for Playwright, Node-RED, and n8n.
short_desc: Anti-detect Firefox Playwright server with Selkies live viewer
author: daijro

form_fields.label: container_name
form_fields.hint: Custom Docker container name. Default: camoufox (if left blank, falls back to camoufox).
form_fields.pattern_error: Must start with a letter or number and contain at least 2 characters (letters, numbers, '.', '_' or '-').

form_fields.label: HEADLESS
form_fields.hint: Browser display mode. Virtual Display enables the Selkies live browser viewer (/viewer/) with stronger fingerprint parity; Native Headless disables the viewer to save memory. Default: virtual.

form_fields.label: ENABLE_VIEWER
form_fields.hint: Enable the integrated Selkies live browser viewer at /viewer/ when HEADLESS is virtual (true or false). Leave blank to keep enabled.

form_fields.label: VIEWER_RESOLUTION
form_fields.hint: Initial virtual display resolution for Xvfb and the Selkies live viewer in WIDTHxHEIGHT format. Leave blank to use 1920x1080.
form_fields.pattern_error: Enter resolution as WIDTHxHEIGHT, such as 1920x1080 or 1280x720.

form_fields.label: WS_TOKEN
form_fields.hint: Optional authentication token required for Playwright WebSocket connections, /json discovery, and the /viewer/ Selkies live viewer. Leave blank to allow unauthenticated local access.

form_fields.label: GEOIP
form_fields.hint: Automatically derive geolocation, timezone, and locale from the container or proxy exit IP (true or false). Leave blank to keep disabled.

form_fields.label: OS_TARGET
form_fields.hint: Target OS family used for fingerprint generation (windows, macos, or linux). Leave blank to randomize across all supported OS families.

form_fields.label: LOCALE
form_fields.hint: Browser locale or comma-separated locales (e.g. pt-BR,en-US). Leave blank to use the generated fingerprint locale.

form_fields.label: BLOCK_IMAGES
form_fields.hint: Block image loading to reduce bandwidth usage (true or false). Leave blank to load images normally.

form_fields.label: BLOCK_WEBRTC
form_fields.hint: Block WebRTC completely (true or false). Leave blank to keep default WebRTC fingerprint spoofing.

form_fields.label: DISABLE_COOP
form_fields.hint: Disable Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy for interacting with cross-origin iframes (true or false). Leave blank to keep default.

form_fields.label: PROXY_SERVER
form_fields.hint: Optional HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy server URL for browser traffic (e.g. http://proxy:8080 or socks5://proxy:1080). Leave blank for direct connection.

form_fields.label: PROXY_USERNAME
form_fields.hint: Optional upstream proxy authentication username. Leave blank if the proxy does not require credentials.

form_fields.label: PROXY_PASSWORD
form_fields.hint: Optional upstream proxy authentication password. Leave blank if the proxy does not require credentials.

form_fields.label: shm_size
form_fields.hint: Shared memory (/dev/shm) size for Firefox and the Selkies display stream. Leave blank to use the default (256m).
